d.title: Maintenance window moved to 22:30
d.summary: The Tuesday maintenance slot moves 90 minutes later from this week.
d.body:
## What changes

Placeholder notice. The weekly maintenance window moves from 21:00 to 22:30 (+08:00) so it no longer overlaps the evening football schedule.

### During maintenance

- Deposits and withdrawals are queued, not lost
- Game sessions are suspended at the end of the current round
- The member area stays readable

### After maintenance

Queued requests are processed in the order they arrived.

d.title: New live casino studios added
d.summary: Two more studio lobbies are now listed in the live casino page.
d.body:
## Two more studios

Placeholder notice. The live casino page now lists two additional studios.

- Their tables appear in the studio rail
- Launching still shows the VPN notice in this build

### Coming next

A filter for table limits arrives with the next update.

d.title: Withdrawal cut-off extended to 23:00
d.summary: Same-day payouts now accept requests until 23:00 on business days.
d.body:
## Later cut-off

Placeholder notice. Same-day payout requests are accepted until 23:00 (+08:00) on business days, two hours later than before.

### What stays the same

- First withdrawal each month is free
- Requests still pass a document check the first time

### Weekend requests

Weekend requests are processed the next business day.

d.title: Number game draws every five minutes
d.summary: The draw interval shortens from ten minutes to five.
d.body:
## Faster draws

Placeholder notice. The number game now draws every five minutes instead of ten.

### What this means for tickets

- A round that closes early is settled at the next draw
- Past results stay in the archive unchanged

### Verification

The public chain commit for each round is published with the result.

d.title: Ranking board adds a weekly race
d.summary: A weekly turnover race joins the five boards already published.
d.body:
## Sixth board

Placeholder notice. The ranking board gains a weekly race board alongside the monthly, VIP and live boards.

- Boards refresh every 15 minutes
- Names stay masked on purpose
- Prizes are credited within 48 hours of a board closing

d.title: Faster deposits with QR channels
d.summary: Two QR channels are added to the deposit page.
d.body:
## QR deposits

Placeholder notice. Two QR channels join the deposit options.

### How it works

1. Open Deposit and pick a QR channel
2. Scan the code in your banking app
3. Keep the reference number for the form

### Limits

Minimum RM 30, maximum RM 3,000 per request.
